name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedLeaf.separator_iff_no_affine_relation
title: Over a field, a leaf separator exists iff the path rows satisfy no affine relation through 0
statement: Over a field K with a finite index type, for row vectors c_z in K^k: there is l with c_z . l = 1 for all z if and only if there is no family alpha with sum alpha_z = 1 and sum alpha_z c_z = 0.
